candidate.answerReason: The three congruent trapezoids together have area 16-1=15, so each has area 5.

methods.label: Subtract and share equally
methods.explanation:
The inner triangle and the three trapezoids fill the outer triangle without overlapping. Subtracting the inner triangle leaves a total trapezoid area of
\[
16-1=15.
\]
Congruent figures have the same shape and size, so the three trapezoids have equal areas. Each therefore has area
\[
15\div3=5.
\]
The answer is \(5\), choice C.
methods.levelReason: Uses elementary area subtraction and division into equal shares, within AMC 8 scope.
